facts.fact: The EAC release on the Meeting of the Technical Committee on Telecommunications, held in Dar es Salaam on 25 to 29 May 2026 to review a draft Regional Mobile Roaming Framework, brings together Partner States and names the Republic of Burundi among the EAC's eight members; it does not single out Burundi's delegation.
